title: Server Rules
summary: The basic rules to check before playing on the NEED server, and how to contact us.

blocks.text: Server Rules
Every player on the NEED server must know the rules below. Breaking them may lead to sanctions at the staff's discretion.

blocks.title: Must Read
blocks.text: These rules keep the server pleasant and play fair. We cannot help with penalties caused by not knowing the rules.

Basic Rules

blocks.title: No unauthorized programs
blocks.text: Macros, auto-hunting, modified clients, external helper programs and any other program not allowed by the staff are prohibited.

blocks.title: No bug abuse
blocks.text: If you find an error, a bug or an abnormal way to obtain rewards, do not abuse it. Report it to the staff.

blocks.title: No real-money trading
blocks.text: Trading accounts, items, Zeny or other currencies for real money or outside goods is prohibited.

blocks.title: No slander or abusive language
blocks.text: Slandering others, abusive or hateful language, provoking disputes and persistent harassment are prohibited.

blocks.title: Sanctions at the staff's discretion
blocks.text: Even in situations not listed here, behavior that harms server order, fairness or stable operation may be sanctioned at the staff's discretion.
Discord Nickname
Your Discord nickname must match your in-game character name. It is used to confirm your identity for inquiries, reports, event entries and reward checks.

blocks.title: Nickname example
blocks.text: If your in-game name is NEED, set your Discord nickname to NEED as well.
Reports and Private Inquiries
For suspected unauthorized programs, bug reports, account inquiries and private inquiries that include personal information, use the Discord inquiry channel.

blocks.title: Use the Discord inquiry channel
blocks.text: Send reports and account inquiries through the Discord inquiry channel, not in a public channel. Including screenshots, your character name, the time it happened and the situation helps us check faster.
The NEED server aims to be a place where everyone can play in a pleasant and fair environment. Please follow the rules, and report any problem through the Discord inquiry channel.
